assumptions: Subtotal read as after discounts: on 334 of 334 discounted orders Subtotal + Shipping + Taxes equals Total. gross_amount = Subtotal + Discount Amount, net_amount = gross - discount - Refunded Amount (shipping and taxes excluded, floored at 0).

checkout_started comes from the abandoned checkouts export only, so it covers abandoned checkouts; a checkout that completed without being abandoned has no checkout_started from Shopify (import Klaviyo's Checkout Started with lcm import auto to cover them). The abandoned checkouts export columns are not documented by Shopify; they were read by their order-export names.
The customers export has no Customer ID column, so user_id is a stable hash of the lower-cased email (em_...), the same id the other mappers make for that address.
First Name, Last Name and the address lines are not imported: the engine needs none of them, and leaving them out keeps personal data out of the canonical tables.
ASSUMED: 719 customer(s) with no order or checkout have no date in any export; their created_at is the start of the export window (2026-01-19 09:53:33), so none of them looks newly signed up.

993 email consent grant(s) dated at the order or checkout whose Accepts Marketing was yes (source checkout), read as captured at that checkout: the earliest time the export shows the customer opted in. A later order with no is read as a revoke.

ASSUMED: 538 customer(s) have Accepts Email Marketing = yes with no dated evidence; consent is dated at their earliest known activity (source import_undated). Dating it early means any real, later unsubscribe from another source wins. Replace with real capture times when you have them.

ASSUMED: 16 customer(s) accepted marketing on an order but have Accepts Email Marketing = no now; the revoke is dated at the end of the export (2026-10-18 23:22:37, source import_undated) so it outranks the earlier grant.
discount_type is left blank: the orders export names the code but not whether it is a percentage, a fixed amount or free shipping.
ASSUMED: 66 refund(s) have an amount but no date in the orders export; each is dated at the order's Canceled at, else at the order time, so revenue is never counted in a period after its refund.
product_id is the Lineitem SKU (the orders export carries no product id), else the line item name; category, URL and image are not in these exports.
warnings: 331 customer(s) have Accepts SMS Marketing = yes, but the export does not say when they opted in. SMS consent needs a dated record (TCPA, 10DLC), so they were NOT marked SMS-consented. Import SMS consent with timestamps (Klaviyo's SMS Marketing Consent Timestamp, or your SMS tool) to enable SMS for them.

assumptions: metrics with no canonical meaning were skipped: Fulfilled Order (1,308)
order_completed.net_amount is Placed Order's $value, which may include shipping and tax depending on the store integration; import the store's own orders (Shopify) for revenue.
product_id is the SKU: 9 Klaviyo ProductID(s) were matched to a SKU through orders and checkouts that carry both, so product events join Shopify line items.
Each profile's Marketing Consent Timestamp is read as the time its current consent status was set (source import). Suppressed is read as revoked: the address cannot be emailed.
ASSUMED: 26 profile(s) are Subscribed with no consent timestamp; consent is dated at the profile's creation (source import_undated), early, so any real later unsubscribe wins.
ASSUMED: 3,849 timestamp(s) carried no UTC offset and were read as UTC.
products: 9 product(s) described from Viewed Product and Added to Cart (newest name, category, URL, image and price seen); merged with a store's own catalog, they only fill blanks.

merge: klaviyo: 3,753 order_completed or checkout_started event(s) were already reported by an earlier source (same order_id or checkout_id) and kept once, from the earlier source.
538 undated consent grant(s) (import_undated) were dropped because another source has dated consent records for the same person and channel.
